other task consumes: `Config` (+ validation + hand-written `Default`), `EffectiveConfig`,
`RunRecord`, `SnapshotSet`, `Tier`, `parse_snapshot_name`, `BackupError` with the `reason=`
vocabulary as an enum, and the public signatures of `verify`/`drill`/`read_runs`/`read_effective`/
`list_snapshots` (bodies may be `todo!()` here; B4-B6 fill them). This is the canonical contract:
the X-tasks build against it.
